capabilities: : Store alignment using plain text markers
disambiguation: Not a general Canvas layout tool; it specifically manages text alignment within nodes and labels while maintaining standard JSON Canvas structure.
extras: The plugin's menus, commands, notices and settings tab are currently in Chinese. It deliberately avoids writing non-standard fields into the .canvas JSON.
intentEvidence: Canvas has no text-alignment setting of its own. Right-click menus offer align and distribute, but those move the cards themselves; they do nothing about where the text sits inside a card.
problem: Obsidian Canvas lacks native controls for aligning text content within cards, labels, and embedded notes.

relations.evidence: Aligning a note that is open on its own moved to the companion plugin Note Text Align

summary: A tool that allows users to align text within Canvas cards, group labels, edge labels, and embedded Markdown note bodies using CSS and plain text markers.
